# MAXIMUM-C manifest -- every restoration that is SAFE to link.
# Generated by tools/gen_all_manifest.py; do not hand-edit.
#
# NOT byte-exact by design: behavioural restorations differ from the
# original by construction, so build-split.sh reports DIFFERS. The
# byte-exact deliverable is src/c/replacements.txt.
#
# Build with BOTH flags -- see AGENTS.md. CODE=FAR fixes the call
# encoding on the C side. ESQ_FARCALLS=1 widens the ASSEMBLY 16-bit
# PC-relative references, which is what used to cap this manifest.
# Without ESQ_FARCALLS=1 the link fails with Error 28, and the message
# blames an assembly unit rather than any restoration.
#
#   ESQ_FARCALLS=1 \
#     SCOPTS="NOSTKCHK DATA=FAR CODE=FAR CODENAME=S_0 DATANAME=S_1 IDLEN=128" \
#     C_REPLACEMENTS=src/c/replacements-all.txt ./build-split.sh
#
# Verified 2026-07-30 at 391 entries: check_pcrel_range clean at 204
# calls, a6_audit 0 of 391, soak 10 of 10 distinct frames,
# menusweep clean on all six ESC-menu items, and framecolor.py
# shows every colour bin overlapping the known-good build.
